mapper.update: update jepm_down set downdate = #{downkey},down='Y' where down = 'N' and shopno = #{shopno}

insert into jepm_all ( jepmcd, jepmnm, makecust, brand, jpmkind, price, setchk, chk, oldbar, remk, prdate, moddate, shopno ) SELECT jepmcd, jepmnm, makecust, brand, jpmkind, price, setchk, chk, oldbar, remk, prdate, moddate, shopno FROM jepm_mst where jepmcd = #{jepmcd} and shopno = #{shopno} and NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jepm_all WHERE jepmcd = #{jepmcd} )

insert into jepm_down ( jepmcd, down, prdate, downdate, shopno, ) select jepmcd,'N',DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'YYYYMMDDHHNNSS'),'',t.shopno FROM jepm_all ,(select shopno from shop_list where shopno != #{shopno} ) t where jepmcd = #{jepmcd}
